notes: Massacre Wurm (M21): 'When this creature enters, creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn. Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, that player loses 2 life.' The -2/-2 affects only the creatures the opponents control as the ability resolves (CR 611.2c). The Wurm enters: seat 1's Bear dies (seat 1 loses 2: 20 -> 18), seat 1's Ogre 4/4 -> 2/2, seat 0's Bear unaffected. Then a 2/2 enters under seat 1's control later this turn: it is NOT affected and survives as a 2/2.
